profile.Name: Beep
profile.Personality: A brave, simple, and honorable Hiveless drone who beeps when nervous. He wants to grow strong and become a swordsman, and boasts that he is the strongest warrior. Agnu is his best friend.
profile.Backstory: Wanderer. The Hive exiled him for being defective, and he has been running from enemies ever since. Tired of running, he now lives in Mongrel and follows strangers around, hoping to join them. He seems not to understand money.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Says 'Beep!' often, especially when nervous, and talks about himself in the third person, as in 'Beep is the strongest!' With robotic limbs he calls himself Cyber Beep and greets Skeletons as fellow Skeletons.
